deals.headline: Sixth Street and Michael Dell join Spurs as strategic partners
deals.summary: Approved by the NBA Board of Governors; Peter J. Holt elevated to managing partner. Minority stakeholders sold to Sixth Street and Dell, nearly halving the shareholder count from 22 to 13 (San Antonio Report). No stake or price disclosed.

deals.evidence: Voters officially signed off on plans for a new $1.3 billion NBA arena for the San Antonio Spurs, approving Proposition B with 52.1% of the vote
deals.headline: Bexar County voters approve funding for $1.3bn downtown Spurs arena
deals.investor: City of San Antonio; Bexar County venue tax; San Antonio Spurs
deals.summary: Proposition B passed with 52.1%; roughly a quarter of funding from the county venue tax, $489m from the city via tax reinvestment, and about $500m from the Spurs; 30-year non-relocation agreement.

ownership_summary: Controlled by the Holt family (in the investor group since 1996), with Peter J. Holt as managing partner since June 2021. In 2021 Sixth Street and Michael Dell bought out minority holders and joined as strategic partners, cutting the shareholder count from 22 to 13; the Holt family remains the largest shareholder.
